result.title: RCFormer: Reliability-aware Context Transformer for Occlusion-Robust Facial Landmark Detection
result.comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
result.summary: Facial landmark detection has advanced substantially under regular imaging conditions, yet occlusion, poor illumination, and large pose changes remain major sources of error because local facial evidence can become incomplete or misleading. Context-guided latent patch recovery offers a promising way to address this issue by inferring unreliable patch representations from surrounding facial context before heatmap prediction. However, the recovered context can itself be unreliable when it is weakly adapted to the input face, influenced by corrupted neighboring patches, or blended without preserving local spatial coherence. We propose RCFormer, a Reliability-aware Context Transformer for occlusion-robust facial landmark detection. RCFormer strengthens latent patch recovery with three reliability-oriented components: visible-context conditioning (VCC), which adapts the context representation using a visibility-weighted global facial summary; visibility-guided context aggregation (VGCA), which reduces the influence of unreliable source patches during attention; and spatial residual correction (SRC), which refines blended latent features using neighboring patch information. The recovered heatmaps are then used as reliability-aware structural cues for existing landmark detection networks. Experiments show that RCFormer improves heatmap recovery and achieves strong landmark localization results on the WFLW, COFW, and 300W datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RCFormer，用于遮挡鲁棒的人脸关键点检测：在热图预测前借助周围人脸上下文恢复不可靠的局部 patch 表示，并用可见性加权上下文调节、可见性引导的上下文聚合与空间残差校正三个模块提升恢复结果的可靠性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「从上下文恢复不可靠视觉表示并按可见性抑制坏 patch」的思路，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、受损视觉细节补全及 latent 假设的可靠性加权相关，但任务是人脸回归而非多模态推理，迁移价值需核查。
